title: Acting on a term another user renamed after the page loaded
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-36 Fourteen.
  • A new name, {Term-B}, that no term has.
    For example: {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S2-36 Renamed.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page is open on the Active tab in both browsers.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Edit".
  3. In {User-B}'s browser, replace the Name with {Term-B}.
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, click "Save Changes".
  5. In your browser, without reloading, click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  6. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  7. Click "Make Default".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {User-B}'s menu opens.
  • Step 2: {User-B}'s "Edit Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 3: the Name reads {Term-B}.
  • Step 4: {User-B} sees the toast "{Term-B} saved".
  • Step 5: your menu opens.
  • Step 6: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 7: the save is refused with the reason the PO gives (see the note); the page keeps its state.

The PRD says a change by another user is refused "with the reason in S2 Error Handling", but none of those texts covers a rename. Question 3 on Chris Ward's sheet (not sent yet) asks; this case is held until he answers.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-E2: “If a term becomes in use, becomes the default, or is changed by another user after the page loaded, the save is refused with the reason in S2 Error Handling, and the page keeps its state.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
